LanguageData.MST.fillPercentComment: The fill percentage of the building, affecting cover effectiveness, passability, etc. Warning: Do not modify this after starting a game, as it can cause pathfinding issues!
LanguageData.MST.isTargetableComment: Whether this building can be manually targeted in combat.
LanguageData.MST.alwaysDeconstructibleComment: Whether this building can always be deconstructed regardless of faction.
LanguageData.MST.alwaysUninstallableComment: Whether this building can always be uninstalled (picked up) regardless of faction.
LanguageData.MST.uninstallWorkComment: Work amount required to uninstall this building.
LanguageData.MST.claimableComment: Whether this building can be claimed by other factions.
LanguageData.MST.repairableComment: Whether this building can be repaired when damaged.
LanguageData.MST.isAirtightComment: Whether this building creates an airtight seal, separating indoor and outdoor environments.
LanguageData.MST.unpoweredWorkTableWorkSpeedFactorCom: Work speed factor when the work table has no power.
LanguageData.MST.workTableNotInRoomRoleFactorComment: Work speed factor when not in the correct room role.
LanguageData.MST.workTableRoomRoleComment: The room role associated with this work table.
LanguageData.MST.fertilityComment: Soil fertility value for this building. Only relevant for buildings that interact with soil.
LanguageData.MST.turretBurstWarmupTimeComment: Turret aim time in seconds, written as min~max; the game rolls a random value in range for each shot. The gun's own verb warmup has no effect on turrets.
LanguageData.MST.damagePerFuelComment: Cost-effectiveness: the nominal damage per 1 unit of fuel item (see the "Fuel" column) = total damage of one burst ÷ items that burst consumes, where items = (fuel per shot × shots + fuel per burst) ÷ fuel multiplier. The numerator is raw damage: no hit chance, no explosion falloff, no difficulty factor. Empty = firing costs no fuel, or the damage does not harm health (e.g. foam turret).
LanguageData.MST.fuelNameComment: The item consumed when refueling (fuelFilter summary): barrels / slugs / rockets for turrets, chemfuel for generators. Read-only. It is also the unit of "1 unit of fuel" in DmgPerFuel — check it before comparing that column across turrets.
LanguageData.MST.fuelCapacityComment: Tank capacity in points. Bursts per tank = capacity ÷ points per burst (fuel per shot × shots + fuel per burst). Only changes how often you refuel, not DmgPerFuel. Example: vanilla mini-turret holds 60 and burns 2 per burst ⇒ 30 bursts per barrel change.
LanguageData.MST.fuelMultiplierComment: How many points one unit of fuel item adds to the tank (points per item; Refuel does fuel += count × this). It only affects refueling, never the points burned per shot, so it is a price conversion: raise it and each item buys more bursts, scaling DmgPerFuel up proportionally. Vanilla varies wildly (mini-turret 0.75, sniper 0.5, rockets 0.067, mortar 20) — not a common scale. With factorByDifficulty the game also divides by the difficulty factor at runtime; that layer is not shown here.
LanguageData.MST.fuelConsumptionRateComment: Points drained per day while idle (points/day, not a multiplier). Only applies to buildings with consumeFuelOnlyWhenUsed = false (generators etc.); turrets burn per shot instead, so this does nothing for them.
LanguageData.MST.aoBuildingConfigComment: Atmosphere Overhaul's building data: fan / jet / compressor / gas tank / humidifier / dehumidifier / mainspring / rain collector / irrigator comps plus the building atmosphere extension. Sections appear only for the comps this building actually has.
LanguageData.MST.aoFanNote: Default power and initial stored energy are copied into the building at spawn: with output adjustment enabled old buildings keep their own value, and initial energy only applies to new ones. Everything else is read every tick.
LanguageData.MST.fanPowerSourceComment: Electricity = grid; StoredEnergy = spring; Unlimited = free. A mainspring fan must use StoredEnergy or AO's config check fails.
LanguageData.MST.fanMaxPowerWattsComment: Upper power limit, which sets the maximum airflow. Vanilla 80.
LanguageData.MST.fanDefaultPowerWattsComment: Initial output at spawn. With output adjustment enabled old buildings keep their gizmo value; without it (spring fan) the value is read every tick. Vanilla 40.
LanguageData.MST.fanRatedFreeAirFlowComment: Volume flow at full power. Vanilla 0.5.
LanguageData.MST.fanOutletAreaM2Comment: Outlet cross-section; affects exit speed and spread. Vanilla 0.12.
LanguageData.MST.fanWindResponsePerTickComment: How fast the fan spins up to its target each tick. Vanilla 0.1.
LanguageData.MST.fanAllowEasyRotationComment: Allow rotating the building in place instead of rebuilding it.
LanguageData.MST.fanAllowOutputAdjustmentComment: Give the building a gizmo to change output. When off, output is always the default power.
LanguageData.MST.fanStoredEnergyCapacityJoulesComment: Only meaningful with the StoredEnergy power source. Vanilla 1000.
LanguageData.MST.fanInitialStoredEnergyJoulesComment: Granted once at spawn; changing it does not affect existing buildings.
LanguageData.MST.aoJetNote: Oxygen fields take percentage numbers (13 = 13%). Flameout must stay below relight or the jet will not light. Intake/outlet geometry and lights are not exposed here.
LanguageData.MST.jetFuelPerSecondComment: Fuel burned per second at full thrust. Vanilla 10.
LanguageData.MST.jetWaterKgPerFuelComment: Water consumed per unit of fuel. Vanilla 1.
LanguageData.MST.jetMaxSpeedComment: Airflow speed at full thrust. Vanilla 90.
LanguageData.MST.jetHalfSpeedComment: Airflow speed at half power. Vanilla 30.
LanguageData.MST.jetMaxTemperatureComment: Exhaust temperature at full thrust. Vanilla 750.
LanguageData.MST.jetMaxPressureRatioComment: Outlet / inlet pressure ratio at full thrust. Vanilla 2.
LanguageData.MST.jetHalfPressureRatioComment: Outlet / inlet pressure ratio at half power. Vanilla 1.1.
LanguageData.MST.jetInletPressureRatioComment: Suction ratio on the intake side; lower pulls harder. Vanilla 0.5.
LanguageData.MST.jetColumnHeightComment: Length of the air column blown upward. Vanilla 5.
LanguageData.MST.jetOxygenConsumptionPercentComment: Percentage of intake oxygen burned per second (8 = 8%/s). Vanilla 8.
LanguageData.MST.jetFlameoutOxygenKPaComment: Flames out below this intake oxygen pressure. Vanilla 12.
LanguageData.MST.jetRelightOxygenKPaComment: Can only relight above this value; must be higher than flameout. Vanilla 14.
LanguageData.MST.jetAllowEasyRotationComment: Allow rotating the building in place instead of rebuilding it.
LanguageData.MST.aoCompressorNote: Target pressure is set from the building's own UI; the max here is just the right end of that slider. Leaving a product def empty uses AO's default tank.
LanguageData.MST.compressorIntakeM3PerTickComment: Volume pulled from the surroundings each tick. Vanilla 1/30.
LanguageData.MST.compressorMaxGoalKPaComment: Upper end of the target-pressure slider in the building UI. Vanilla 150.
LanguageData.MST.compressorSeparateOxygenComment: Compress oxygen into oxygen tanks instead of plain air tanks.
LanguageData.MST.compressorOxygenProductDefComment: Empty = AO_OxygenTank. Only used when oxygen separation is on.
LanguageData.MST.aoGasTankNote: Oxygen takes a percentage number. Burst temperature is Celsius; the tank's own temperature is simulated by AO and is not affected here.
LanguageData.MST.gasTankOxygenPercentComment: Percentage number released with the gas (21 = air). Vanilla 21.
LanguageData.MST.gasTankExplodeAboveCelsiusComment: The tank explodes above this temperature. Vanilla 200.
LanguageData.MST.aoHumidifierNote: Target humidity is a per-building saved value (CompHumidifier.goalPercent), not a Def field, so it is set from the building's own UI instead.
LanguageData.MST.humidifierMaxKgPerHourComment: Water evaporated per hour at full power. Vanilla 1.
LanguageData.MST.aoDehumidifierNote: Same as the humidifier: target humidity is a per-building saved value, not a Def field.
LanguageData.MST.dehumidifierSweptVolumesComment: Room volumes of air processed per interval. Vanilla 1.
LanguageData.MST.aoMainspringNote: Winding time applies immediately; auto-rewind is copied into the building at init and saved, so it only affects new buildings. This comp requires a fan with the StoredEnergy power source on the same def.
LanguageData.MST.mainspringWindingTicksComment: Ticks to wind the spring fully; must be positive. Vanilla 180.
LanguageData.MST.mainspringAutoRewindComment: Read once at building init and saved; only new buildings are affected.
LanguageData.MST.aoRainCollectorNote: Capacity is in water units; 1 unit = 0.25 kg.
LanguageData.MST.rainCollectorCatchmentM2Comment: Rain-catching area, which sets the hourly yield. Vanilla 1.
LanguageData.MST.aoIrrigatorNote: Spray ticks times session mm sets how much one session waters; the next session starts only after the check interval, and rest ticks is the pause between sessions.
LanguageData.MST.irrigatorSprayRadiusComment: Radius covered by the spray head. Vanilla 9.
LanguageData.MST.irrigatorPumpRadiusComment: How far away it can draw water from. Vanilla 3.
LanguageData.MST.irrigatorSprayTicksComment: How long one spray session lasts. Vanilla 300.
LanguageData.MST.irrigatorSessionMmComment: Millimetres delivered in one session. Vanilla 20.
LanguageData.MST.irrigatorCheckIntervalTicksComment: How often it checks soil dryness to start the next session. Vanilla 2000.
LanguageData.MST.aoBuildingExtNote: All four factors are relative to the value AO derives from hit points: 1 = standard, 0 = no leak / no heat exchange. Only buildings that already carry this extension are affected (in vanilla: geothermal generator, cooler, vent, gravship hull, vac barrier). Adding the extension to other buildings is a structural change this mod does not do.
LanguageData.MST.buildingPressureToleranceComment: x the pressure rating AO derives from hit points. 1 = standard, 5 = gravship hull, 1000000 = vac barrier.
LanguageData.MST.buildingWindToleranceComment: x the derived wind rating. 1 = standard, 1.7 = what AO gives coolers and vents.
LanguageData.MST.buildingAirPassableComment: Pawns cannot pass but air can (the geothermal generator works this way). Drag is scaled by the fill percent below.
LanguageData.MST.buildingAirFillPercentComment: -1 = use the def's own fillPercent; 0.5 = half filled (the geothermal generator's value).
